title: Fintech Risk & Compliance Lead
description: Drive financial risk modeling, regulatory compliance framework, payment gateway security, and fintech advisory for premier banking & capital market institutions.
details:
### Role Overview
Join a dynamic fintech & capital markets team as a Risk & Compliance Lead overseeing financial regulatory frameworks, anti-money laundering (AML), and transaction security.

### Key Responsibilities
- Design & implement financial compliance architectures aligned with RBI, SEBI, and global financial standards.
- Conduct quantitative risk assessments, fraud detection modeling, and audit reviews for digital payment systems.
- Collaborate with fintech developers and wealth management advisors to ensure compliance in new financial products.

### Requirements
- Master's in Finance, CA, CFA, or equivalent Financial Risk Management (FRM) certification.
- 5+ years of experience in financial services, fintech compliance, or investment banking risk management.
